When youmove out of your apartmentandleave Germany, you must deregister your address at theBürgeramt. This is called theAbmeldung. This guide explains why it’s important, and how to do it.

You must do yourAbmeldungif… Youmove out of GermanyFor example, if you move out of your Berlin apartment, and you move to Canada. oryou have multiple homes, and you leave one of themFor example, if you have apartments in Berlin and Hamburg, and you move out of the Hamburg apartment. Do not do yourAbmeldungif… You will return to the same addressFor example, if you study in France for 3 months, then move back to the same address in Germany. You move to another address in GermanyFor example, if you move from Berlin to Munich. When youregister your new address, your old address is automatically deregistered. You have notregistered your address

You must deregister to… Stop being a German resident Stop paying taxesin Germany When you deregister, you get a deregistration certificate (Abmeldebescheinigung). With this certificate, you can… Stop paying theTV tax Cancel your Germanhealth insurance Cancel your phone, internet, electricity, gas and gym contracts Get arefund of your pension payments

There are 4 ways to deregister your address: In person at theBürgeramtIt’s the fastest way to get anAbmeldebescheinigung. You need it to cancel your contracts and yourhealth insurance. By emailIt’s easier, but you might not get yourAbmeldebescheinigungin time. By post Pay someone to deregister you Deregister minimum 7 days before youmove out, and maximum 14 days after you move out.1If you wait longer, it’s okay. Some people take months to deregister, and nothing bad happens.9 When you deregister, you get anAbmeldebescheinigung. This document confirms that you are deregistered. If you deregister in person, they give it to you. If you deregister by email or by post, you must ask for this document, and they will send it to you.2

title: In person at the Bürgeramt
text: This is thesafest option, because you always get anAbmeldebescheinigung. To do yourAbmeldungin person… Book an appointmentforAbmeldung einer Wohnung. Choose anyBürgeramtin Berlin. If there are no appointments available, check again every few minutes. Fill theAbmeldungform Go to your appointment. Bring:TheAbmeldungform, filled and signedYour passport orPersonalausweis, not a copy12A proof of your move-out date, if you deregister late (optional)10 TheAbmeldungform, filled and signed Your passport orPersonalausweis, not a copy12 A proof of your move-out date, if you deregister late (optional)10 If you deregister multiple people, you must also bring… Their passport orPersonalausweis, not a copy13 If yousend someone elseto deregister you, they must also bring… AVollmachtfor each person to deregister. Usethis template. The appointment takes around 10 minutes. If you don’t speak German, you probably won’t need help, but you can still bring a translator. During your appointment, you will get anAbmeldebescheinigung.

title: By email
text: This is theeasiest option, but it’s not 100% reliable. EachBürgeramtdoes things differently. They rarely email yourAbmeldebescheinigung. They might refuse to mail to another country, so you must give them a backup address in Germany. To deregister by email, send this message toanyBürgeramtin Berlin: Generate an email to ask the Bürgeramt to deregister your address. This tool requires JavaScript to work. Attach this to your email: TheAbmeldungform, filled and signed A copy of your passport orPersonalausweis A proof of your move-out date, if you deregister late (optional)10 If you deregister multiple people, also attach… A copy of their passport orPersonalausweis A signedVollmachtfor each person you deregister Write your new address in the form. If you use a German address, andyour name is not on the mailbox, use “c/o” or “bei” on the address form. You will get anAbmeldebescheinigung1 to 4 weeks later.3They usually send it by regular post, not email orregistered mail. They might refuse to send it to another country.

title: By post
text: Send the same documents and message as when youderegister by email. There is no reason to do yourAbmeldungby post. It’s slower, but not more reliable. How to mail a letter— from your computer, without a printer

title: Pay someone to do it
text: These companies can deregister your address: Deregistration.de EasyAssist They will deregister your address, and send you aderegistration certificateby email. It’s expensive, but it’s faster and 100% online. They can also cancel yourTV tax, yourhealth insurance, and your other contracts.
When you deregister, you lose your official address in Germany. This has consequences.

title: Taxes
text: TheAbmeldungtells theFinanzamtthat you have left the country, and that you don’t need to pay taxes in Germany.5You might still have to pay taxes in Germany if you have a residence, investments or a business in Germany. Taxes after leaving Germany

title: Residence permit
text: Yourresidence permitorpermanent residencedoes not expirewhen you deregister your address. It only expires if you leave Germany “non-temporary reasons”. Your German citizenship never expires. When does a residence permit expire?

title: Health insurance
text: German health insurance is only for German residents. When you deregister, you can lose your German health insurance coverage.6If you want to keep your health insurance, you probably should not deregister. **Health insurance and leaving Germany

title: Social security
text: When you deregister, you might stop receivingGrundsicherung,ElterngeldKindergeldand other social services.7Those services are only for German residents. You can getALG Iin another EU country for up to 6 months.

title: Bank account
text: You can keep your German bank account, even if you deregister your address andleave Germany.4You need it to get yourapartment deposit, last paycheck, yearly bonus and tax return. If the bank sends you a letter, and it can’t be delivered, they might freeze your bank account.8If they freeze your bank account, you can’t withdraw money, use your credit card, or makebank transfers. Bank accounts and leaving Germany

title: Vehicles
text: You can’t own a vehicle registered in Germany if you don’t live in Germany.6Some people had a different experience, so there are exceptions to this.

title: Other services
text: When you deregister, you get anAbmeldebescheinigung. Use it tocancel your phone, internet and electricity contractswithout fees or delays.7

If you already left Germany, do yourAbmeldungby email or by post.11TheBürgeramtwon’t punish you, but they might refuse to send yourAbmeldebescheinigungto your address abroad. You canpay someone to deregister you, receive yourAbmeldebescheinigung, and forward it to you. It’s safer.
